    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            combined with the last name to compose the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On read this is the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street types expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment).
            Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed 'address' when
            present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'

          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+()0-9 ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's postal code. Optional; when present it must be exactly 4 digits and
            valid for the city's region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present it is
            used to derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-

            with the same last name and postcode are already the same household. A second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected as a household duplicate (409); setting this flag
            true only bypasses that block, declaring the owner an intentional household member. A
            declared member is created and is not flagged as a possibleDuplicate. Write-only; never

          writeOnly: true
          example: true

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the honorific 'title' followed by a single space and the
                last name (e.g. 'DR who') when a title was supplied, or just the last name when
                no title is present.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: a '+' and the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the
                owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the decimal digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit characters such as '-' are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate (e.g. 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted
                'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts
                on 1 July and is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to the next year's fiscal year
                (e.g. 2 July 2025 -> 'FY26', 30 June 2026 -> 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic household identifier: the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over
                '<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'. Assigned to every owner, so owners with the same
                last name and postcode share it automatically.
              type: string
              example: '9f86d0818884'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identity: the lower-case hex SHA-256 of
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail or empty>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Duplicate
                rejection (409) is decided by this single key — a second owner whose telephone,
                email and last-name soundex all match an existing owner's is a duplicate unless it
                sets sharesHousehold. Two owners with the same last name and postcode but a
                different telephone have different keys and are created as a soft match.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points: starts at 0, +2 when an email is present,
                +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more members, and
                +3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July),
                counted from the registrationDate's fiscal year to the current fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, derived from membershipPoints:
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same business day (counted by registrationDate); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city already contained
                between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the per-city capacity limit of 50); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, an existing owner shared the
                same lastName and postcode but had a different telephone (a soft, non-blocking
                duplicate); otherwise false. Always false for an owner created with
                sharesHousehold=true, since a declared household member is not a suspected duplicate.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches on lastName and postcode
                (with a different telephone). Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region using the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC ->
                Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is
                'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older.
                Present only when the request supplied a birthDate.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment as '<TIER>_<AREA>', one of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA
                is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record. Soft-deleted
                owners are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
